title: suggest result record (v1)
description: One logical suggestion as one JSONL result record: the original zero-based position in the upstream results array, the constant suggest bucket, the suggested query completion, and the usable textual members a rich suggestion carried — the suggestion kind plus the enriched title, description, and image url. Absent members are omitted, never emitted as null; the deprecated upstream is_entity flag is not carried because type is its documented replacement.

suggestion_type.$comment: The kind of suggestion the upstream result named: query or entity; unrecognized kinds stay plain query suggestions.

title.$comment: The enriched title a rich suggestion carried.

description.$comment: The enriched description a rich suggestion carried.

img.$comment: The enriched image url a rich suggestion carried.
